title: Verify Robot Location model fields and location types/statuses used by RMS orange locations
summary: Using the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) read-only access surface, verify the Robot Location database model table includes the expected location attributes (station number, occupied, zone, closeout zone, location type, max AGVs, dwell-time tracking) and that the enumerated location types/statuses match the RMS orange location categories (sorter/tipper/hospital/shut down/GLD pre queue).
when_to_use: When you need to confirm that RMS orange location categories are backed by the expected Robot Location model/table definition in the WCS/Robotics database (fields present and location type/status enumerations match the expected categories).
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Perform read-only verification of Robot Location model/table fields and enumerated location types/statuses in WCS / Helix DB (SSMS).

access_required: wcs_sql (SSMS read-only access to OptiSweep/WCS database)

visual_references.description: Robot Location database model table content: expected location attributes and the listed location types/statuses that correspond to RMS orange locations.

steps.title: Open WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) read-only access surface
steps.purpose: Establish access to the OptiSweep/WCS database where the Robotics database model table definitions are stored.
steps.instruction: Use the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) access surface to connect to the OptiSweep/WCS database that contains the Robotics database model table definitions for the Robot Location model.
steps.expected_result: SSMS is connected to the OptiSweep/WCS database that contains the Robotics database model table definitions for the Robot Location model.
steps.healthy_condition: You can browse the database objects needed to locate the Robot Location database model table definition.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot connect to the expected OptiSweep/WCS database or cannot access the Robotics model/table definitions needed to locate the Robot Location model table.

actions.label: Connect to OptiSweep/WCS database in SSMS
actions.exact_action: In SSMS, connect to the OptiSweep/WCS database that contains the Robotics database model table definitions for the Robot Location model.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Robot Location database model table contains station number, occupied, zone, closeout zone, location type, Max number of AGVs allowed, and whether tracked for dwell time; lists location types/statuses including sorter/tipper/hospital/shut down/GLD pre queue categories.

steps.title: Locate Robot Location database model table and verify required location attributes
steps.purpose: Confirm the Robot Location model table includes the expected location attributes used by RMS orange locations.
steps.instruction: In SSMS, locate the Robot Location database model table definition and verify it includes fields/attributes for: station number, occupied (occupied or not), zone, closeout zone, location type, Max number of AGVs allowed at that location, and whether the location should be tracked for dwell time there.
steps.expected_result: The Robot Location database model table definition shows the expected location attributes: station number, occupied, zone, closeout zone, location type, Max number of AGVs allowed, and dwell-time tracking (tracked vs not tracked).
steps.healthy_condition: All required attributes are present in the Robot Location model/table definition with names/meaning consistent with the expected set (station number, occupied, zone, closeout zone, location type, max AGVs, dwell tracking).
steps.failure_condition: One or more required attributes are missing from the Robot Location model/table definition or are named differently than expected such that the mapping cannot be confirmed.

actions.label: Verify required fields exist in Robot Location model/table
actions.exact_action: Locate the Robot Location database model table and verify it includes fields/attributes for: station number, occupied (occupied or not), zone, closeout zone, location type, Max number of AGVs allowed at that location, and whether the location should be tracked for dwell time there.

stop_or_escalate_if: If required fields (station number, occupied, zone/closeout zone, location type, max AGVs, dwell-time tracking) are missing or named differently than expected, escalate to deeper model/catalog review.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Robot Location database model table contains station number, whether occupied or not, zone, closeout zone, location type, Max number of AGVs allowed, and whether tracked for dwell time.

steps.title: Verify Robot Location model includes expected location types/statuses for RMS orange categories
steps.purpose: Confirm the enumerated location types/statuses in the Robot Location model match the RMS orange location categories.
steps.instruction: In the same Robot Location model/table definition, verify the listed location types/statuses include the categories: sorter entrance queue, sorter queue, sorter exit queue; tipper, tipper queue, tipper exit queue; hospital drop off, hospital entrance queue, hospital pickup, hospital exit queue; queue shut down, off the end shut down queue; GLD pre queue entrance, GLD pre queue exit.
steps.expected_result: The Robot Location model/table definition includes the named location types/statuses for sorter/tipper/hospital/shut down/GLD pre queue categories.
steps.healthy_condition: All listed categories appear in the Robot Location model/table definition (as location types/statuses) with names consistent with the expected set.
steps.failure_condition: One or more expected location types/statuses are missing from the Robot Location model/table definition.

actions.label: Check enumerated location types/statuses list
actions.exact_action: In the same Robot Location model/table definition, verify the listed location types/statuses include the categories named in the segment: sorter entrance queue, sorter queue, sorter exit queue; tipper, tipper queue, tipper exit queue; hospital drop off, hospital entrance queue, hospital pickup, hospital exit queue; queue shut down, off the end shut down queue; GLD pre queue entrance, GLD pre queue exit.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the named location types/statuses (sorter entrance/queue/exit, tipper/queues, hospital queues, shut down queues, GLD pre queue entrance/exit) are missing from the Robot Location model, escalate because RMS orange location categories may not be backed by the expected model.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Listed location types/statuses include: sorter entrance queue, sorter queue, sorter exit queue; tipper, tipper queue, tipper exit queue; hospital drop off, hospital entrance queue, hospital pickup, hospital exit queue; queue shut down, off the end shut down queue; GLD pre queue entrance, GLD pre queue exit.

steps.title: Cross-check RMS orange location categories map to the same Robot Location types/statuses
steps.purpose: Ensure the Robot Location model’s location types/statuses correspond to the RMS orange locations categories.
steps.instruction: Using the Robot Location model/table definition you verified, confirm that the segment’s RMS orange location categories correspond to the same named location types/statuses you see in the Robot Location model/table definition.
steps.expected_result: The RMS orange location categories map consistently to the location types/statuses present in the Robot Location model/table definition.
steps.healthy_condition: The set of location types/statuses in the Robot Location model/table definition matches the expected RMS orange categories (sorter/tipper/hospital/shut down/GLD pre queue).
steps.failure_condition: The RMS orange categories cannot be mapped consistently because the Robot Location model/table definition lacks or differs from the expected location types/statuses.

actions.label: Validate mapping consistency
actions.exact_action: Cross-check that the segment’s statement about RMS orange locations is consistent with the location types/statuses you see in the Robot Location model (i.e., the RMS orange location categories map to the same named location types/statuses).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the mapping is inconsistent (e.g., missing or mismatched location types/statuses), escalate to deeper model/catalog review.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: These are all the orange locations that are shown on RMS, and the listed location types/statuses are the orange location categories.

success_criteria: Robot Location model/table definition includes required location attributes: station number, occupied, zone, closeout zone, location type, max AGVs, dwell-time tracking.

Robot Location model/table definition includes expected location types/statuses: sorter entrance/queue/exit; tipper/tipper queue/tipper exit; hospital drop off/entrance queue/pickup/exit queue; queue shut down/off-the-end shut down; GLD pre queue entrance/exit.
RMS orange location categories map consistently to the same named location types/statuses in the Robot Location model/table definition.
healthy_conditions: All required Robot Location attributes are present in the model/table definition.
All expected location types/statuses are present in the model/table definition.
The RMS orange location categories correspond to the same named location types/statuses listed in the Robot Location model/table definition.
failure_conditions: One or more required Robot Location attributes are missing or named differently such that the expected set cannot be confirmed.
One or more expected location types/statuses are missing from the Robot Location model/table definition.
RMS orange location categories cannot be mapped consistently to the Robot Location model/table definition.
escalation_guidance: Escalate to deeper model/catalog review if required fields are missing/mismatched or if expected location types/statuses are missing, because RMS orange location categories may not be backed by the expected model.
